Hi Sophie — thanks for the context and the RFP.

Quick answer: you're right to call out DST. The US (our side) moves clocks forward on Sun Mar 8, so if we schedule for the week of Mar 9-13 the LA times in calendar invites will shift. To avoid confusion I recommend we either:
1) pick a date after the EU switches (after Mar 29), or
2) lock the invite using a single canonical timezone (e.g., "10:00 UTC / 11:00 CET / 03:00 PDT") and call it out in the invite text, or
3) use two quick options and have attendees accept the one that works.

For your windows, I can do Wed Mar 11 at 15:00 CET (which is 07:00 PDT on our side pre-DST, but 08:00 PDT after Mar 8). Because of the DST changeover on Sun Mar 8 the LA display will flip. If your attendees prefer not to deal with that, let's target Mar 16+ to be safe.

Happy to send a couple of time options in UTC to make it explicit.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
